title: Retrieval teams for crashed triangular craft

tellings.quote: I know a man two different people who've been on the retrieval teams of the triangular ones.

plain: Special teams have gone out to recover crashed triangle-shaped craft, according to Steven Greer, a doctor and activist who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs. Greer says he knows "two different people who've been on the retrieval teams of the triangular ones," but he does not name them, and he tells it as proof that such craft are being collected in secret.
